description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.</p></div><h3><strong>What is The Role</strong></h3> <p><span data-offset-key="aui03-0-0"><span data-text="true">We are looking for a skilled </span></span><span data-offset-key="aui03-0-1"><span data-text="true">QA &amp; Evaluation Engineer</span></span><span data-offset-key="aui03-0-2"><span data-text="true"> to join our team. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.</p> <p>We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.</p> <ul> <li>Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary</li> <li>Health coverage for you and your family in many locations</li> <li>Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles</li> <li>Generous number of vacation days each year</li> <li>Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service</li> <li>Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love</li> <li>Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave</li> </ul> <p>Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Some teams work in the office full-time; others have a hybrid arrangement (they work remotely some days and in the office some days) and some work entirely remotely.​</span></span></p> <p>This is a hybrid position. You’ll divide your time between working remotely from your home and an office, so you should live within commuting distance. Hybrid teams may work in-office as much as a few times a week or as little as once a month or quarter, as decided by leadership. The hiring manager can share more about what hybrid work might look like for this team.</p> <p><strong>Join Our Team</strong></p> <p>GoDaddy is empowering everyday entrepreneurs around the world by providing all of the help and tools to succeed online. GoDaddy is the place people come to name their idea, build a professional website, attract customers, sell their products and services, and manage their work. Our mission is to give our customers the tools, insights and the people to transform their ideas and personal initiative into success.</p> <p>Our Identity team is looking for a Software Engineer to join us in building and maintaining GoDaddy's customer identity platform. As a software engineer on our team, you will work in an Agile scrum environment, contributing to the development and maintenance of mission-critical services that serve as the authoritative source of truth for all GoDaddy customer profiles, identity verification, and consent management. You'll be working with modern cloud-native architectures, handling billions of requests, and ensuring the highest standards of security and compliance for customer data.</p> <p><strong>What you'll get to do...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design, develop, and maintain backend services and RESTful APIs using Java and Spring Boot for GoDaddy's customer profile and identity platform</li> <li>Build scalable, event-driven microservices on AWS (DynamoDB, Kinesis, Lambda, ECS/Fargate, S3, OpenSearch), including real-time integrations with internal systems and third-party vendors</li> <li>Deliver secure, GDPR-compliant solutions by implementing identity verification, consent management, encryption, audit trails, and API security controls including WAF</li> <li>Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code; participate in code reviews, troubleshoot production issues, support on-call operations, and contribute to CI/CD and infrastructure automation</li> <li>Take ownership of features from design through deployment, collaborate across engineering and product teams, solve problems independently, and leverage AI tools to improve productivity</li> </ul> <p><strong>Your experience should include...</strong></p> <ul> <li>3+ years of professional software engineering experience building backend services, APIs, and distributed applications</li> <li>Strong proficiency in Java and Spring Boot, with solid understanding of RESTful API design and microservices architecture</li> <li>Experience with relational or NoSQL databases, cloud-native development, Git, testing frameworks, and CI/CD practices</li> <li>Understanding of data structures, algorithms, software design patterns, security fundamentals (authentication, authorization, encryption), and API security concepts</li> <li>Strong problem-solving, debugging, communication, and ownership skills, with the ability to independently drive features from design to delivery</li> </ul> <p><strong>You might also have...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with AWS technologies including DynamoDB, Kinesis, Lambda, ECS/Fargate, OpenSearch, CloudFormation, and WAFv2</li> <li>Knowledge of event-driven architectures, message streaming platforms (Kinesis, Kafka, SQS/SNS), API gateways, GraphQL, and OpenAPI/Swagger</li> <li>Familiarity with security and compliance best practices, including encryption, KMS, PII protection, GDPR, and audit trail requirements</li> <li>Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, observability tools (CloudWatch, Datadog, Splunk), and additional backend languages such as Go or Python</li> <li>Experience in Agile environments, passion for engineering excellence, continuous learning, and effective use of AI-powered development tools</li> </ul> <p><em>We encourage you to apply even if your experience or skillset doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement. We value a wide range of backgrounds and transferable skills, and we are excited to support learning and growth.</em></p> <p><strong>We've&nbsp;got your back...</strong><strong> </strong>We offer a range of total rewards that may include paid time off, retirement savings (e.g., 401k, pension schemes), bonus/incentive eligibility, equity grants, participation in our employee stock purchase plan, competitive health benefits, and other family-friendly benefits including parental leave. <p>P-926</p> <p>At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers — and customer obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to solve technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started in&nbsp;<strong>Bengaluru , India</strong> ! As a software engineer with a backend focus, you will work with your team to build infrastructure for the Databricks platform at scale.</p> <p><strong>The impact you'll have: </strong></p> <p>Our backend teams cover a diverse range of domains, from core compute fabric resource management to service platforms and infrastructure. For example, you might work on challenges such as:</p> <ul> <li>Supporting Databricks' growth by building foundational infrastructure platforms that enable seamless operation across numerous geographic regions and cloud providers.</li> <li>Implementing cloud-agnostic infrastructure abstractions to help Databricks engineers more efficiently manage and operate their services.</li> <li>Develop tools and processes that drive engineering efficiency at Databricks. We enhance the developer experience for Databricks engineers across various areas, including programming languages, linters, static analysis, IDEs, remote development environments, automated release pipelines, and test automation frameworks. Our current focus is on optimizing the Rust development experience across the organization.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we look for:</strong></p> <ul> <li>BS (or higher) in Computer Science, or a related field</li> <li><strong>6+ years</strong> of production level experience in one of: Python, Java, Scala, C++, or similar language.</li> <li>Experience developing <strong>large-scale distributed systems</strong> from scratch</li> <li>Experience working on a SaaS platform or with Service-Oriented Architectures</li> <li>Proficiency in one or more backend languages such as Java, Scala, or Go.</li> <li><strong>Hands-on experience in developing and operating backend systems</strong>.</li> <li>Ability to contribute effectively throughout all project phases, from initial design and development to implementation and ongoing operations, with guidance from senior team members.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About Databricks</strong></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, sans-serif;">Databricks is the Data and AI company. <div class="content-intro"><p>HackerRank helps companies like NVIDIA, Amazon, and Microsoft hire and upskill the next generation of developers based on skills, not pedigree. Our platform is trusted by over 2,500 of the world’s most innovative companies to build strong engineering teams ready for what’s next.<br><br>Software has entered an era where humans and AI build side by side. As this shift accelerates, the definition of strong technical talent is changing. We give companies better ways to identify and invest in next-generation skills.<br><br>People at HackerRank care deeply about the impact of their work and sweat the small details so our customers can be wildly successful with products they genuinely love to use. We move with urgency and believe great outcomes come from high standards.</p></div><h4><strong>About the role</strong></h4> <p>Customer Experience Engineering is where customers, product, and engineering meet. As a CXE 1, you’ll investigate real technical problems across our platform, APIs, integrations, data, and customer workflows. You’ll learn to trace issues to root cause, communicate clearly with customers and internal teams, and build the judgment to own increasingly complex work independently.</p> <p>This is not a traditional support role built around scripts and handoffs. You’ll work in one shared CXE queue, use AI as part of your everyday engineering toolkit, and contribute to the knowledge, automation, and product improvements that prevent repeat problems. CXE 1 is designed as a transition into CXE 2 as your depth, independence, and customer readiness become consistently visible.</p> <h4><strong>What you will do</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Own standard and moderately complex customer issues from first investigation through resolution and closure.</li> <li>Debug web application, API, integration, authentication, configuration, and data issues using logs, developer tools, SQL, and established investigation patterns.</li> <li>Communicate clearly and empathetically across tickets, calls, incidents, and internal channels; ask precise questions, set expectations, and close every loop.</li> <li>Work with CXE 2 engineers on complex, high-risk, or enterprise cases, taking on greater ownership as your readiness grows.</li> <li>Create structured escalation reports for confirmed product issues and stay accountable for progress and customer closure when Engineering is involved.</li> <li>Use AI tools safely to accelerate investigation, validate hypotheses, improve responses, correct support-agent outputs, and strengthen team knowledge.</li> <li>Turn learning from customer issues into better documentation, runbooks, product feedback, and small automation or tooling improvements.</li> <li>Protect shared queue health by prioritising accurately, meeting service levels, documenting work cleanly, and helping rebalance work across shifts.</li> <li>Participate in rotational shifts and on-call coverage, including occasional evenings or weekends, to support global customer needs.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Who you are</strong></h4> <ul> <li>A recent graduate or early-career engineer with up to 3 years of relevant experience. Strong freshers are encouraged to apply.</li> <li>Strong programming fundamentals and comfort reading code; experience with Python, JavaScript, Java, or a similar language.</li> <li>Familiarity with REST APIs, HTTP, web applications, and how software systems communicate.</li> <li>Working knowledge of SQL and an interest in using data to investigate and validate behaviour.</li> <li>Curious and systematic: you want to understand why something failed, not just make the error disappear.</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communicator who can explain technical ideas in plain language to customers and engineers.</li> <li>Comfortable asking for review when risk or uncertainty is high, then applying the feedback quickly.</li> <li>Open to rotational shifts and occasional on-call coverage across a global customer base.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Even better if you have</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Built a project, script, bot, or automation that solved a real problem.</li> <li>Worked with logs, observability tools, cloud platforms, SSO/SAML/OAuth, or third-party integrations.</li> <li>Used AI coding tools such as Claude, Cursor, Copilot, or similar and can explain how you validated their output.</li> <li>Contributed to an open-source project, hackathon, internship, or production codebase.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>You will thrive here if</strong></h4> <ul> <li>You enjoy ambiguous technical problems and are persistent enough to find the real cause.</li> <li>You care equally about technical correctness and how the customer experiences the resolution.</li> <li>You learn fast, seek feedback, and turn new knowledge into repeatable practice.</li> <li>You solve rather than route and take pride in leaving no loose ends.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Want
